Name: Growable Forage and Crop Bushes
Description:
[center]﻿﻿Languages: English 🇺🇸 - Brazilian Portuguese 🇧🇷 - Simplified Chinese 🇨🇳 - German 🇩🇪 - Spanish 🇪🇸 - French 🇫🇷 - ﻿Italian 🇮🇹 - Japanese 🇯🇵 - Korean 🇰🇷 - Russian ﻿🇷🇺 - Thai 🇹🇭 - Turkish[b] 🇹🇷 [/b][/center]
[b][i][center]This mod is an add-on for the Cornucopia mod series![/center][/i][/b]
Have you ever wanted a true vineyard, or a forested area filled with berry bushes and mushroom stumps? Now you can have it! Bushes typically give a much higher per-day profit, in return for their slower growth time and the space they take up out of season. A good choice for greenhouses!
[size=4]
[color=#ea9999]----[b]IMPORTANT!!![/b] This mod CHANGES how some crops work. READ the [b]description[/b] and [b]config options [/b]before installing!-----[/color][/size]
[center]
[img]https://imgur.com/QO3hCLy.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[list]
[*]Plantable crops for [b]spring onions[/b], [b]ginger[/b], [b]crocus[/b], and [b]sweet pea[/b]
[*]New mushroom planters for [b]chanterelle[/b], [b]morel[/b], and [b]common mushroom[/b]
[*]New plantable bushes for [b]salmonberry[/b], [b]blackberry[/b], and [b]holly[/b]
[*]Turns [b]grapes[/b], [b]cactus fruit[/b], [b]blueberry[/b], [b]coffee beans[/b], and [b]hops[/b] into "bushes", so they'll survive year-round without watering, but only produce in their normal season
[*]New fruit trees for growing [b]hazelnut[/b] and [b]coconut[/b]
[/list]
Everything is fully configurable, and you can choose which plants you want or don't want. Bush and planter items act like vanilla teabushes, which means they're planted in untilled soil, don't require watering, take a while to mature, and will stay there year-round.

Purchase planting items from Pierre, mushroom planters from the Dwarf, and ginger seeds from the Island Trader.

Bush items require [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20619]Custom Bush[/url][/b]. You can play without it, but you won't get any of the bush features from this mod.

This mod was made to complement [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url], but you can play without it. If you want some more custom crops and bushes, consider checking Cornucopia out!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4946087]Princess of Evil[/url] created a companion mod for this that also turns [b]strawberries, cranberries, and starfruit[/b] into bushes called [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20951]Growable Vine Crops[/url].
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/ZoeyHoshi/about-me?gameId=1303]ZoeyHoshi[/url] created [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25619]Vanilla Forage Crops and Bushes[/url] which adds even more growable crops for the rest of the vanilla forage items.
[center]
[img]https://imgur.com/LRY9aFQ.png[/img][/center][b]
Cornucopia is a joint project between [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/55537262]6480[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2821799]MizuJakkaru[/url]. The two of us work together on everything, including mod design, artwork, writing, and code![/b]

If you'd like to support the project, we'd really appreciate if you checked out our [url=https://www.patreon.com/cw/StardewCornucopia]Patreon[/url] page. The Cornucopia mods take months and months of work, as well as frequent fine-tuning and updates for new content. Plus, there's some extra goodies and monthly progress updates! You can join for free if you only want to see the updates.

If a one-time donation is preferable, we both have ko-fi pages: [url=https://ko-fi.com/6480k]6480[/url] - [url=https://ko-fi.com/mizujakkaru]MizuJakkaru[/url]
